context:
Goal: the tracking-stamp merge (the later tracking time wins) and the restore-stamp change work on the real Worker that holds your check-in data.
Problem (risk): a live Worker deploy changes real check-in data and needs your word; the tracking-stamp merge is on main with tests, nothing is deployed to the live Worker, and the restore-stamp change is not built yet.
Based on (read): the records, tests and code for the tracking-stamp merge are on main; the restore-stamp change builds after the Hand end-of-day change (PR 390), which is parked behind the red Pro-phone shards.
Based on (ruling): your 2026-11-21 20:27 CST answers: the latest tracking wins, and restore stamps are ignored.
Departs from: main has no live deploy of the tracking-stamp merge — the Worker would run the new merge.
Waiting on: your answer; the other lanes run, and the deploy waits.
Unvetted: the question reviewer's check against past rulings could not run (its answer did not parse), so none of this was checked against them.

options.gain: Your phone and the Worker agree on tracking stamps sooner.
options.how: The coordinator deploys the tracking-stamp merge to the live Worker; the restore-stamp change deploys after it builds.
options.label: Deploy the tracking-stamp merge now
options.lose: A live change to real check-in data with no macOS-proven app build behind it, and a second deploy later for the restore-stamp change.

options.how: The coordinator deploys the tracking-stamp merge and the restore-stamp change in one live deploy once PR 390 merges.
options.label: Deploy both together after PR 390 merges
options.lose: The tracking-stamp merge waits for the parked Hand end-of-day change, for a time nobody can state yet.

short: Live Worker deploy: tracking-stamp merge now, or both together later

shown.label: Deploy both together after PR 390 merges

title: When should the tracking-stamp merge go to the live Worker?
why: Deploying both together means one live change to your data, tested as a pair (coordinator's recommendation).
